about: What port/tools/hostgen/release.py and release_carry.py need of this release besides the decompilation and the primary release's port: its ids, the decompilation's places for it, and the pairs checked by hand, each with its evidence.
title: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando (PAL)

The entry hooks the overrides carry (0x003D2898 in level 2, 0x00448968 in 6, 0x00409F00 in 9) jal this function's copy in their level on the disc (0x003335E0, 0x0036E2B0, 0x00329DF0). func_V1_L00_002B55F0_1.why: rac2-decomp's func_PAL_L00_002B5518 (src/pal/levels/shared/L00_002B5518-cc.c) is its PAL copy of func_L00_002B55F0, which the release table could not pair (the C calls it by its _1 spelling, which the release's build gave no value); call_copies.tsv pairs this caller's call with it in every level (func_L00_002B59B0 -> func_L00_002B5518 at level 0). ref_L00_003DD6A8_00.why: PAL's levels' Spider Bot update (rac2-decomp src/pal/levels/shared/L01_003E4058-sw-g8.c) reuses the executable copy's ref_L00_003DD6A8_ names, which PAL's release table values with the executable's functions; each level's copy calls func_L00_00327350 here, not the executable's func_002B0C18

ref_L00_003DD6A8_12.why: PAL's levels' Spider Bot update (rac2-decomp src/pal/levels/shared/L01_003E4058-sw-g8.c) reuses the executable copy's ref_L00_003DD6A8_ names, which PAL's release table values with the executable's functions; each level's copy calls helper_set_active_flag (func_L00_003BBCE0) here, not the executable's moby_set_linked_flag (func_003188B8). The executable's reads its pointer at 0x001AF8F0, a float (0.04) in Todano, so the bot's blast crashed reading 0x3D23D772

ref_L00_003DD6A8_18.why: PAL's levels' Spider Bot update (rac2-decomp src/pal/levels/shared/L01_003E4058-sw-g8.c) calls the level's own hero state change when the bot lands (28: the hero steers the bot) and when it ends (0); PAL's release table values the name with the executable's empty level hook func_PAL_0026F5B8, which the levels' copies never call (each jals its level's function: func_L11_002D9038 in Joba, func_L12_002C8C58 in Todano). Named so, the hero never took control: the next update saw game mode 28 missing and blew the bot up at once, without its blast (T-101). func_L00_002C4480 is this call's row in call_copies.tsv, so each level reaches its own copy's target
